home.welcomeBody: New here? Learn everything about TBTs on the {roast}. And set up your {profile} as a creator, collector, or both — it’s used whenever you create or acquire a TBT, and it appears on the work’s page.

sections.roastNote: Roast — learn everything about TBTs. What a Transferable Billable Token is, how certification works, royalties, and verification. The onboarding surface, in the spirit of an “NFT 101.”
sections.grindNote: Grind — the discovery floor. Browse, critique, share, and compare TBTs. (The Charts live here.)
sections.brewNote: Brew — where a creator makes a TBT: upload the work, set price and royalties, and certify it on-chain. The first TBT auto-creates “Collection 1.”

errors.expired: The code expired. Request a new one.

auth.successSub: Your identity is verified. You’re connected to your TBTs and the blockchain.

authHub.needSignIn: Sign in to manage your authentication.
authHub.recoveryHint: To recover your account if you lose your phone.
authHub.privateCodeHint: Asked in addition to the SMS code, per the frequency you choose.

privateCode.title: Private code
privateCode.description: Between {min} and {max} characters. Will be asked in addition to the SMS code.
privateCode.disclaimer: Stored as a hash, never in plain text. A short code is a convenience layer, not a real second factor.
privateCode.pcResetNote: Forgot it later? Reset it with your recovery email.
privateCode.pcResetNoteNoEmail: Tip: add a recovery email so you can reset this if forgotten.

recoveryEmail.title: Recovery email
recoveryEmail.description: Used to recover your account if you lose your phone, and as extra confirmation.
recoveryEmail.checkEmailDesc: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Once you open it, the email is verified and you can use it to recover your account if you lose your phone.

biometric.title: Biometric sign-in
biometric.description: Register this device with your fingerprint or face. Biometrics never leave the device — we only store a public key. It adds to the SMS code, never replaces it as your identity.
biometric.chooseMode: How do you want to use biometrics on this device?
biometric.quickDesc: One touch identifies you, no SMS code on this device.
biometric.extraDesc: Biometrics required in addition to the SMS code.
biometric.registeredDesc: You can now use biometrics on this device.
biometric.doneQuick: On this device, a touch signs you in.
biometric.doneExtra: Biometric will be required in addition to your login code.

biometricSignIn.title: Quick sign-in
biometricSignIn.description: Enter your phone to locate your registered device.
